issues.detail: The contract assumes prev_in updates on every posedge including reset, so a 1 sampled on a reset-active cycle can become the previous value for the first reset-released cycle. Under R_FALL, that can set out=1 on the first cycle after reset. S01 only specifies sticky capture of 1-to-0 changes and active-high synchronous reset; it does not specify whether reset clears or suppresses prior input history for transition detection. For the listed sequence, the contract resets out on cycle 1 while setting prev_in=1, then captures 1-to-0 on cycle 2 and sets out=1. An alternative reset-clears/suppresses-history semantics would leave out=0.
issues.spec_evidence: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next. "Capture" means that the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset).
issues.alternative: Reset clears or disables previous input history for transition detection, so a 1 observed while reset=1 followed by 0 on the first reset=0 cycle is not captured; out remains 0.
